about_the_product.title: boAt Airdopes 141 Gen 2 – Wireless Earbuds with 48 Hours Playback
about_the_product.description: The boAt Airdopes 141 Gen 2 TWS Earbuds in Teal provide an impressive 48 hours of playtime, making them ideal for extended listening sessions. Equipped with Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC) technology, these earbuds ensure superior sound clarity. The IPX4 rating offers water resistance, making them suitable for workouts and outdoor use. With Bluetooth version 5.4, they provide seamless connectivity and are compatible with a variety of devices. Their ergonomic design ensures comfort during prolonged use.
